notes: While 爸爸 is the most common way to address or refer to one's father, you may also hear 父亲 (fùqīn). 父亲 is more formal and is typically used in writing or when talking about someone else's father in a respectful, distant context.
The second character 爸 is often written without a tone mark (ba) in casual speech, though it is standard to write it with the fourth tone.
